description.en: Loads a 2D image/texture resource (e.g. a tutorial illustration or title-screen background) and returns a handle usable with the other 2D display commands (CMND_SET_POSRY, CMND_SET_ALPHA, CMND_DELETE_IMAGE, ...).
Internal name to register the image under.
Path to the image file, e.g. "data/ep_bg.xa".
Resource pool slot to load into.
Name of the animation/variant within the image resource to use.

example.code:
// Load a full-screen background image
local imgHdl = CMND_LOAD_IMAGE("\x0083^\x0083C\x0083g\x0083\x008bBG", "data/ep_bg.xa", 1, "ep_bg");
